habitat: Evergreen and semi-evergreen forest, forest edge, bamboo thickets, secondary growth, shaded plantations; mid-storey to canopy perches; 0–2400 m
description: Glossy black drongo with hair-like nape feathers and a deeply forked tail with curled outer feathers; bold mimic; evergreen and semi-evergreen forest, forest edge and bamboo thickets of the Jammu foothills (0–2400 m); sallies for flying insects from mid-storey/canopy perches.
